scope: offline engineering, no fitting or real fixture samples

targets.T1: K02/K03/K04: joint FT1X2 -> strict devig -> ordered probabilities -> coverage/scoring; positive controls and semantic mutants.
targets.T2: K10: extend native artifact receipt interface with explicit run comparison and exclusion/probability change report; no service or new framework.
targets.T3: K01: cache invariant NB/DC parameters outside support probes; extend alpha boundaries without claiming unbounded caller coverage.

market.snapshot: one common snapshot_id and captured_at; latest received snapshot, no fallback from incomplete/suspended latest

numeric.domain: finite positive means with representable NB probabilities, alpha 1e-4..3; strict positive DC factors. Caller means have no finite global bound; support fail expected for extremes.
numeric.conditional: DNB non-draw conditional probabilities; report denominator and conservative error bound 2*(candidate_tail+reference_tail)/reference_denominator capped at 1; no unconditional tolerance claim.
numeric.cost: interleaved old/new 3 repetitions on fixed 3 interior cases after warmup; report median ratio, experimental goal >=2x without accuracy regression; operational latency budget UNKNOWN.

workflow.inputs: explicit own SYNTHETIC fixtures only in demonstration; no recursive reading of result directories
workflow.acceptance: same ordered probabilities as formula for controls; every excluded fixture retained; no score from excluded fixture; compare refuses different universe or policy; changed input/code hashes visible; duplicate JSON keys and overwrites rejected
workflow.resources: existing managed Python/numpy/scipy; JobObject 768MiB one process; 120sec timeout; sanitized env + Python audit hook, not native-code OS sandbox
